pagination.note: ES 1.7.x; single _search capped at 3,000 docs. Per-company: POST term query on cvrNummer with sort offentliggoerelsesTidspunkt desc. Full/incremental: scroll, or range-filter on sidstOpdateret.

transport.rate_limit: max 3,000 docs per query; scroll for bulk; be polite

parsing.notes: Metadata only — no figures. Filter offentliggoerelsestype == 'regnskab'. Pick the document(s) with MIME application/xml or application/xhtml+xml for structured parsing; skip image/tiff and application/pdf as unstructured. _index name varies; key on _id. Document downloads are gzip-compressed even when text/xml.

mapping_rules.documents: dokumenter[] -> {type: dokumentType, mime: dokumentMimeType, url: dokumentUrl}.
mapping_rules.supersede: omgoerelse == true marks a correction that supersedes an earlier filing for the same period.

fixture_requirements: modern filing with XBRL + iXBRL + ESEF documents (e.g. Maersk Q1-2026)
old filing with only an image/tiff AARSRAPPORT (no structured figures)
company with multiple filings across years (ordering by offentliggoerelsesTidspunkt)

live_test_plan.smoke: POST {"query":{"term":{"cvrNummer":22756214}},"sort":[{"offentliggoerelsesTidspunkt":{"order":"desc"}}]}; assert hits.total > 0 and a dokumenter[] with application/xml. POST match_all size=0 and assert hits.total ~ 6,295,759.
live_test_plan.full: Scroll the whole index (or incremental on sidstOpdateret), persist NDJSON, then hand document URLs to the cvr_regnskab_xbrl downloader. Gate full crawl behind an explicit env flag.
